pending_interview.question: You joined a team six months ago as a senior manager. You recently discovered that one of your strongest technical leads has been consistently dismissing ideas from two newer team members in public settings — cutting them off, attributing their ideas to others, and subtly undermining their credibility with stakeholders. The technical lead is well-liked by senior leadership and delivers excellent work. Both newer team members have come to you separately and described feeling sidelined. How do you handle this?
